narrationTexts: Two real bugs, confirmed by comments in the code itself. Fixing both.
finalText:
**Build's green now: 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, not noise:

1. `[options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7)` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `[retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8)` threw on `undefined` flags, but the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Added an `undefined` case that treats it as disabled.

Rest of the screen was just deprecation and dedupe noise. `node build.js` now exits 0 with 8 warnings, all cosmetic.
